subject: Mean lines with stat_summary() not showing up

messages.author: eca99c51870663ea
messages.subject: Mean lines with stat_summary() not showing up
parts:
I'm doing a scatterplot with a categorical variable on the x axis, and another categorical variable that's color-coded. I also want to add in lines that track the mean values, but they're not showing up.

I'll illustrate what I'm trying to do, using the diamonds data (I hope the inline images show up properly):

dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100), ]

# No lines show up
qplot(color, carat, data=dsmall, colour=cut,
      position=position_jitter(width=.25, height=0)) +
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="line")


# It works if you convert the x-axis variable from a factor to numeric
qplot(as.numeric(color), carat, data=dsmall, colour=cut,
      position=position_jitter(width=.25, height=0)) +
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="line")


# It works if you use bars for the mean values
qplot(color, carat, data=dsmall, colour=cut,
      position=position_jitter(width=.25, height=0)) +
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="bar", position=position_dodge())



So it looks like the problem has something to do with trying to use lines with categorical variables. Is this the expected behavior, and if so, how does one work around it?

-Winston

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Mean lines with stat_summary() not showing up
parts:
stat_summary(aes(group = cut), fun.y=mean, geom="line")

See section 4.5.3 of the book for why.

Hadley
